name: Booked In
maturity: Built and tested with live email; subscription billing not yet live, and three features not built.

brand.tone: Warm, plain-spoken and candid, written in British English for working beauty professionals rather than technologists, and careful never to oversell.

facts.text: Booked In is a booking page built for solo beauty professionals.

source.quote: **A booking page for solo beauty professionals.**

facts.text: Her clients book themselves from a link in her Instagram bio.

source.quote: Her clients book themselves, from a link in her Instagram bio.

facts.text: It is made for people running a beauty business on their own.

source.quote: and what it does for someone running a beauty business on her own.

facts.text: Lash technicians who currently manage their diary through Instagram DMs are a core audience.

source.quote: A lash technician's diary lives in her Instagram DMs.

facts.text: It serves both technicians who travel to clients and those who work from home, a rented chair or a shop.

source.quote: The other half works from a room at home, a chair rented in a salon, or a shop

facts.text: Booking by DM means late-night availability questions, and by the time she replies the client has often gone quiet and the slot stays empty.

source.quote: By the time she answers, the client has gone quiet and the slot is still empty.

facts.text: Marketplace booking sites show her client other technicians nearby; Booked In keeps the page hers alone.

source.quote: her photographs, her prices, her link, and no marketplace

facts.text: Most booking platforms leave patch-test compliance to the technician, even though a missing dated record can put her insurance cover at risk.

source.quote: **Every booking platform treats this as her problem.**

facts.text: The rebooking reminder a studio means to send often never gets sent.

source.quote: it is simply the message a studio means to send and never does.

facts.text: There is no commission, no marketplace, and nobody else is advertised on her page.

source.quote: No commission, no marketplace, and nobody else advertised on her page.

facts.text: Bookings arrive while she is working, so she no longer has to be the bottleneck.

source.quote: She never has to be the bottleneck. Bookings arrive while she is working on

facts.text: Changes to prices, hours, photographs or days off go live on her page as soon as she saves them.

source.quote: is live on her page the moment she saves it.

facts.text: Double booking is prevented at the database level, so two clients cannot take the same slot.

source.quote: ## Nothing can double-book

facts.text: Pro includes Rebooking, which emails a client once when she is about due for her next treatment, with a link straight to a free time.

source.quote: It is deliberately hard to misuse. It is off until she turns it on, even though

source.quote: A treatment that needs a test cannot be booked by

facts.text: She chooses whether clients come to her, she travels to them, or both, and her page and diary adapt to match.

source.quote: So where the appointment happens is now something she says, once, and three

facts.text: A technician working from home is never asked to publish her home address on her page.

source.quote: A technician working from a room at home must

facts.text: A client's address is remembered against her record, so regulars never type it twice.

source.quote: An address a client gives once is remembered against her record, so a regular

facts.text: The Share tab creates Instagram Story cards from her real diary in a tap, showing only times long enough for the chosen treatment.

source.quote: The **Share** tab draws one from her real diary in a tap

facts.text: She can add one colour of her own on top of her trade's palette, and the rest of the card's colours are derived from it.

source.quote: she can give one colour on top of that, from which the rest is derived in HSL

facts.text: The card preview sits inside an Instagram-style frame so she can see what will be covered before she posts.

source.quote: The preview sits inside Instagram's own frame

facts.text: Pages load nothing from third parties except Cloudflare Web Analytics, which sets no cookie and writes nothing to the visitor's device.

source.quote: Cloudflare Web Analytics, which the privacy notice describes and which the build adds only when `CF_ANALYTICS_TOKEN` is set. It sets no cookie and writes nothing to the visitor's device

facts.text: Row level security keeps each studio's client list separate from every other studio's.

source.quote: where row level security can keep one studio's client list away from every

facts.text: There are three tiers: Free, Pro at ten pounds a month, and Pro+ at twenty-four pounds.

source.quote: what Free gives her, what Pro adds at ten pounds a month, what Pro+ adds at twenty-four

facts.text: Every booking page carries "Powered by Booked In" on every plan, including Pro, while no Story card carries the Booked In mark on any plan.

source.quote: **No card carries our mark any more**, on any plan. It used to come off at Pro; `028` removed it altogether. The booking page still carries "Powered by Booked In" on every plan

facts.text: Email is live, but subscription billing is not: it has never taken a payment against a real account.

source.quote: taken a payment against a real account, and it should not be described as

source.quote: It has, however, been run end to end against a **Stripe sandbox**: a real

facts.text: A custom domain per studio, rescheduling and publishing straight to Instagram are not built and must not be described as features.

source.quote: **A custom domain per studio, rescheduling and publishing straight to > Instagram are not built.**

facts.text: Publishing to Instagram depends on a third party's approval queue rather than on code, so it should not be promised.

source.quote: `platform/INTEGRATIONS.md` sets out what Instagram publishing needs. It is > gated on somebody else's approval queue rather than on code

facts.text: Pro+ costs £24 and adds the waiting list that fills a cancellation within the minute.

source.quote: At £24 it adds the waiting list that fills a cancellation within the minute

facts.text: On Pro+, the insurance pack gathers every dated patch test and appointment for a client into one record of the kind an insurer asks for after a reaction.

source.quote: **the insurance pack**: every dated patch test and every appointment for one client, in one call, as the record an insurer asks for after a reaction.

facts.text: The patch-test rule is included free on every plan; paid tiers sell the chasing and paperwork, not the safety rule.

source.quote: **The patch-test rule itself is free and always will be**

facts.text: Pro includes deposits, paid straight to her and never through Booked In.

source.quote: Pro also carries **deposits** — paid straight to her, never through us —

facts.text: Booked In cannot verify that a deposit has arrived, so she marks it as received herself.

source.quote: nothing here can verify a > deposit arrived, so she marks it received

facts.text: Booking emails go out from the verified booked-in.co.uk domain through Resend, and real confirmations have reached real inboxes.

source.quote: `booked-in.co.uk` is verified > with Resend and real confirmations have been delivered to real inboxes

facts.text: Her page's palette comes from her trade, set at signup, with no decision for her to make.

source.quote: So the palette comes from her trade now, set at signup, with no decision for her to make.

facts.text: A colour palette that fails the readability checks is rejected rather than shipped.

source.quote: a palette that fails any of them is **rejected rather than shipped**

facts.text: It isn't only for lash and brow studios: a man booking a skin fade or a sports-therapy clinic doesn't get a pink page.

source.quote: A man booking a skin fade does not want a pink page; nor does a sports-therapy clinic.

facts.text: Patch-test checks are switched on automatically at signup according to her trade.

source.quote: It is turned on from the trade at signup, because a setting that arrives switched off is a setting nobody finds.

facts.text: Her page will not accept a client address that is just a town, without a house number or postcode.

source.quote: will not accept a town without a number or a postcode

facts.text: A single client coming back one extra time in a year covers the subscription several times over.

source.quote: A single client coming back one extra time in a year covers the subscription several times over.

facts.text: Booked In is at booked-in.co.uk.

source.quote: `booked-in.co.uk` is verified

facts.text: The page is hers: her photographs, her prices, her link, and no marketplace showing her client three other technicians nearby.

source.quote: **the page is hers**: her photographs, her prices, her link, and no marketplace showing her client three other technicians nearby.

facts.text: A client asks at eleven at night whether Saturday is free; by the time she answers, the client has gone quiet and the slot is still empty.

source.quote: By the time she answers, the client has gone quiet and the slot is still empty.

facts.text: If a client reacts and the studio cannot produce a dated patch-test record, the insurance meant to cover it may not.

source.quote: If a client reacts and the studio cannot produce a dated record, the insurance that was supposed to cover it may not

facts.text: There is a Free plan, and the patch-test rule is on it as well as on the paid plans.

source.quote: **The patch-test rule itself is free and always will be**
